verdict.rationale: Solid's README states it skips a Virtual DOM: it compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions. The compiler is wired in via babel-preset-solid, and only the code that depends on changed state reruns. Community users independently confirm the surgical-update performance ("next level" DOM performance, 50x faster player rebuild, granular updates without wasted re-renders). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of what the compiler emits and how it transforms components (the pack has only one-line mentions).
